record.what_it_does: Vonage's API Platform (formerly Nexmo) provides communications APIs for SMS, voice calls, messaging (WhatsApp/Messages), video, verification/2FA, and number management that developers integrate into applications.
record.auth_notes: No OAuth2 for third-party API access is documented. Most APIs use API Key+Secret (either as request params or Base64 Basic Auth header); newer/advanced APIs (Voice, Video, Conversation, Messages advanced features) require RS256-signed JWTs generated from an Application ID + private key. Messages and Verify support either JWT or Basic auth, with JWT recommended for webhooks/ACLs.
record.access_notes: Signing up on vonage.com creates an account with an API key/secret immediately, and the pricing page states 'Try it free. Start developing now with free credit. No credit card required.' Ongoing production use is pay-as-you-go metered billing (no subscription needed), and some features (e.g., dedicated phone numbers for SMS/Voice, WhatsApp sender registration) require additional setup/approval.
record.main_blocker: No OAuth2 for third-party/multi-user apps — a toolkit must manage per-user API key/secret or JWT+private-key credentials directly

evidence.quote: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using... API Key and Secret (Header), JSON Web Token (JWT)
